recipe.visualDefinition: A structured 4x6 grid of monochrome photographs showing feet in motion, overlaid on a technical graph paper background with a bold header bar and vibrant geometric line accents.
coreVisualRelationships: Rigid mathematical grid vs. organic human movement
High-contrast black and white photography vs. saturated neon vector lines
Technical graph paper texture vs. street-level urban photography
Horizontal header dominance over vertical grid repetition
coreInvariants: White graph paper background with thin black lines
Black header bar with yellow italicized typography
Single-color neon 'V' or 'Y' shaped lines originating from feet

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A repetitive 24-cell grid occupies the central 85% of the frame, with each cell containing a medium-close shot of feet.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The solid black horizontal bar at the top containing the primary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Scanning motion from top-left to bottom-right, guided by the rhythmic repetition of the grid cells.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The white graph paper gutters between the photo cells provide breathing room and structural integrity.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and black provide the structural foundation and photographic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Yellow is used exclusively for the primary display text to ensure maximum legibility against black.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon pink, cyan, lime green, and orange are used for the geometric dance-step lines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value white background contrasts with low-value black photos; accents are at maximum saturation.
paletteRestrictions: No mid-tone grays in the background

characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning to create a solid block of color
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all text to maintain a bold, industrial look.
graphicDevices: Neon vector lines indicating movement paths

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, industrial, and clean look of the era.
Captures the wide, square-ish proportions common in 70s tech-inspired design.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 4x6 grid of 24 unique monochrome street-style photographs of people's feet dancing on pavement. Place these on a white graph paper background. Overlay each photo with a single-color neon geometric 'V' shape in colors like pink, blue, or green.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a solid black horizontal bar across the top. Inside the bar, center a single line of text using an extra-bold, extended, italicized sans-serif font in bright yellow.

verificationChecks: Are the photos strictly black and white?
Is the yellow text highly legible against the black bar?
Do the neon lines appear as flat vector overlays?

postGenerationChecks: Check that no two adjacent cells use the same neon color.
Ensure the graph paper lines are visible in the gutters.
Verify the text is fully contained within the black header bar.
Confirm the italic slant of the text is consistent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Grid of [Subject] + Graph Paper + Black Header + [Bold Extended Italic Font] + Neon Vector Overlays
